sections.title: Bio
sections.content:
Rachel Marie Hannon started writing the day after her first kiss. Slightly less cute than it sounded, she didn't have anyone to talk to. She genuinely thought she was a whore. In college, Rachel made sure she had a class each semester where she could write about trees and her feelings. Now that Rachel is in her thirties, I Might Be An Idiot feels like a really natural extension of the work she began back then. 

Working remotely and living with her parents, I feel really blessed to have this time to write about love. Thank you all for being a part of that journey.

sections.title: About
sections.content: I Might Be An Idiot follows my determined search for popularity as I maintain trails in Arizona following a suspension from Bucknell University.

paragraphs.text: When things get worse it forces me to search for the reason why all these things kept happening to me. In the end… well, you read the title.
